[EN] I have a favor to ask. We're supposed to be observing the Black Claw orcans, but we're overrun with {@LinkCreature:41#1003#sable sabertooths} and {@LinkCreature:41#1002#noralk kamaras}.

Keeping their numbers down doesn't leave us much time, not to mention the problem of injuries. Will you join the hunt while you're here? {@LinkCreature:241#1003$$Jaebel} will pay you.
[ES] Tengo un favor que pedir. Supuestamente debemos vigilar a los orcans de Black Claw, pero estamos plagados de {@LinkCreature:41#1003#sable sabertooths} y {@LinkCreature:41#1002#noralk kamaras}.

Mantener sus números bajos no nos deja mucho tiempo, sin mencionar el problema de las heridas. ¿Te unirás a la cacería mientras estás aquí? {@LinkCreature:241#1003$$Jaebel} te pagará.

[EN] You've helped us a great deal. I'd like you to have this token of our gratitude.
[ES] Nos has ayudado muchísimo. Me gustaría que tengas esta muestra de nuestra gratitud.
